mathematics.assertion_tested: Definition-first independent exact checks of 13 new lesson families: seed cancellations, tap reduction with boundary numerator, formal reciprocals, Catalan integration coefficients, both factorial conjugation directions, Bernoulli argument translation, causal and periodic differences, and six finite Fibonacci capstone operations.

mathematics.conventions: Causal samples vanish at negative indices. Ordinary z and coarse u denote causal delay. N maps raw count a_n to Taylor coefficient a_n/n!. Complete FIR tails retained unless explicitly comparing four-prefix truncated causal difference. P8 uses F0=0,F1=1 and first 8 samples. No author generator imported.

non_claims: Finite checks do not prove universal identities; separate elementary derivations are required.
No Lean certificate, global novelty determination, noisy recovery, continuous reconstruction, numerical precision, or stability certificate.
